headline: SLC Agrícola Completes Acquisition of Grupo Radar Properties for R$669M
summary: SLC Agrícola concluded the purchase of Grupo Radar properties for 669 million reals, adding roughly 11,100 hectares of land, of which about 8,900 hectares are arable.
why: Agricultural land acquisitions expand production capacity for major farming enterprises, influencing scale and asset valuations in the agribusiness sector.

impacts.name: SLC Agricola
impacts.why: Large-scale land acquisition expands the company's agricultural production footprint.
